info.title: ASA Server Manager API
info.description: REST API for managing ARK: Survival Ascended Server instances

get.summary: List all instances with basic configuration
get.description: Returns a list of all server instances including their running status and basic configuration information

post.summary: Restart all server instances with real-time progress
post.description: Restarts all server instances with Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream for real-time progress updates. Returns streaming progress messages for each instance restart.

200.description: Restart in progress - returns SSE stream with progress messages

post.summary: Create a world-save backup of an instance

get.summary: List world-save backups for an instance

post.summary: Restore a world-save backup to an instance
post.description: Restores the worldfile (SaveDir content) from a backup file to a server instance. If the instance does not exist, it will be created automatically.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Instance name (will be created if it doesn't exist)

post.summary: Update ARK server with real-time progress
post.description: Downloads and updates the ARK server files using SteamCMD. Returns Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream with real-time progress updates.

200.description: Update in progress - returns SSE stream with progress messages

get.description: Returns Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream with server resource information updated every 200ms. Includes system CPU usage, memory usage, and detailed metrics.

200.description: Server info stream - returns SSE stream with resource information every 200ms

get.description: Returns Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream with game instance resource information updated every 200ms. Gets instance PID by port and monitors process resource usage.

200.description: Instance info stream - returns SSE stream with process resource information every 200ms

500.description: Server error - instance not found or config load failed

get.description: Retrieves both Game.ini and GameUserSettings.ini from the base server directory (ShooterGame/Saved/Config/WindowsServer)

404.description: Configuration files not found in server base directory

get.description: Retrieves both Game.ini and GameUserSettings.ini for a specific instance

404.description: Configuration files not found for instance

put.summary: Update Game.ini content directly via text

post.summary: Synchronize game config files from base server to instances
post.description: Syncs Game.ini and GameUserSettings.ini files from the base server directory to instance Config folders. Only updates entries that don't exist in the instance configuration files, preserving existing instance-specific settings.

post.summary: Sync instance configuration and files from source to multiple target instances
post.description: Synchronizes instance configuration (ModIDs, CustomStartParameters, ServerPassword, ServerAdminPassword, EnableAsaPlugin) and entire Config folder from a source instance to multiple target instances. Target instances keep their other configuration fields (ServerName, Port, RCONPort, QueryPort, MaxPlayers, MapName, SaveDir, ClusterID) intact.

put.summary: Update GameUserSettings.ini content directly via text

get.summary: WebSocket connection for real-time server events
get.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection to receive real-time broadcast events for all server instances. Client should send a ClientMessage with client_id on connection. All connected clients receive the same events globally.

101.description: Switching Protocols - WebSocket connection established and ready to receive events

get.summary: WebSocket connection for RCON command execution
get.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection for interactive RCON command execution. Each command is executed independently with a temporary RCON connection to the specified instance. No persistent connection state is maintained.

101.description: Switching Protocols - WebSocket connection established for RCON commands

get.summary: Stream FRP client status changes via SSE
get.description: Real-time stream of FRP status changes. Only sends updates when status changes (every 1 second check).

200.description: SSE stream of FRP status events

get.description: Parses the ARK save file and returns player data using go-arkparser
Parses the ARK save file and returns tribe data using go-arkparser
Returns cached snapshot data from arkmonitor. Falls back to synchronous parsing if cache is unavailable. The cached data uses arkmonitor's typed snapshot format (PlayerSnapshot/TribeSnapshot).

200.description: Save data retrieved (cached snapshot or parsed)

get.summary: Stream save data changes via SSE
get.description: Streams real-time save file change events. arkmonitor watches the .ark file and broadcasts snapshots via SSE when changes are detected. Sends cached data immediately on connect, then streams updates.

200.description: SSE stream of save data events

get.description: Returns mod information extracted from server logs (mod ID and name mappings)
Returns Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream with resource information for all running instances every 2 seconds. Includes CPU usage, memory usage, and process details for each instance.

200.description: SSE stream of all instances resource info (every 2s)

get.description: Returns the 256px PNG icon for a creature by its raw display name. The name is normalized (special characters replaced with `_`, consecutive underscores merged, leading/trailing underscores trimmed) before looking up the embedded icon file.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Raw creature display name, e.g. `Alpha T-Rex`, `Dinopithecus King (Gamma)`

404.description: Icon not found for the given name

get.description: Returns the 256px PNG icon for an item by its raw display name. The name is normalized (special characters replaced with `_`, consecutive underscores merged, leading/trailing underscores trimmed) before looking up the embedded icon file.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Raw item display name, e.g. `Absorbent Substrate`, `Some Item (Special)`

404.description: Icon not found for the given name

backup_file.description: Path to the backup file. Restoring always replaces the worldfile (SaveDir content) only

MapName.description: Name of the map to use

MapName.description: Name of the map to use

EnableAsaPlugin.description: Whether ASA plugins are enabled for the server

target_instances.description: List of target instance names to sync to

error.description: Error message if file not found

game_user_settings.description: GameUserSettings.ini configuration file for the instance

error.description: Error message if file not found

filename.description: Name of the updated configuration file

ClientMessage.description: Message sent from WebSocket client to server (for heartbeat, connection identification, etc.)

client_id.description: Unique client identifier provided by the client

ServerUpdateSSEStream.description: Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream for real-time server update progress

data.description: Progress message from the update process

update_ark_server.value: data: Downloading and updating ARK server files...

error.value: data: Error: Failed to download SteamCMD: network error

ServerInfoSSEStream.description: Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream for real-time server resource information (updated every 200ms)

data.description: Server resource information in JSON format

error.value: data: {"error":"Failed to get memory info: connection error"}

InstanceInfoSSEStream.description: Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream for real-time instance resource information (updated every 200ms)

data.description: Instance resource information in JSON format

running.description: Whether the instance is currently running

pid.description: Process ID of the running instance

cpu_percent.description: CPU usage percentage (0-100+, can exceed 100 on multi-core systems)

memory_used.description: Memory used by process in bytes (RSS)

memory_percent.description: Memory usage percentage of total system memory (0-100)

instance_not_running.value: data: {"error":"Failed to get PID: no process found on port","instance":"my-server","running":false}

error.value: data: {"error":"Failed to get process info: process not found","instance":"my-server","pid":12345,"running":false}

ServerEvent.description: Server event message sent via WebSocket (global broadcast to all connected clients)

instance_name.description: Name of the server instance that triggered the event (empty for connection event)

RCONMessage.description: Message sent from WebSocket client to server for RCON operations

instance_name.description: Name of the instance (required for command action)

command.description: RCON command to execute (required for command action)

ServerRestartAllSSEStream.description: Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream for real-time restart progress of all instances

data.description: Progress message for instance restart operations

restart_failed.value: data: Error: Failed to restart instance 'server-1': connection timeout

error_summary.value: data: Error: 1 of 3 instances failed to restart

response.description: RCON command execution response (for command action)

TribeID.description: Tribe ID the player belongs to

Members.description: List of player IDs in the tribe

CachedSaveData.description: Cached save snapshot data from arkmonitor (used by cache and SSE broadcast)

players.description: Map of player ID to PlayerSnapshot

tribes.description: Map of tribe ID to TribeSnapshot

players.description: Array of player data maps from ExportPlayers

tribes.description: Array of tribe data maps from ExportTribes

SaveSSEStream.description: Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream for save data changes (powered by arkmonitor)

players.description: Number of players in snapshot (complete event)

tribes.description: Number of tribes in snapshot (complete event)

cached.summary: Initial cached data sent on connect

AllInstancesInfoSSEStream.description: Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream for all instances resource information (every 2s)
